note: sfx: When the bordermoon collapses, the nearby miasma is purified.

en: Kukuku...  I'll tell you something useful.
Are you finding all the materials you need for your dresses?
The monsters who drop patterns often also carry the materials required to sew them.
I can understand your desire to rush ahead,
but it would be worthwhile to take time out to collect materials every now and again, don't you think?
En garde, you monster!
W-wait.  Hold your horses there.
Eh?!
Please don't trample me.  Let us discuss for a while.
Talk this out, you say?  With you, a monster?
Oh I can understand your skepticism.
But being able to resolve differences through parley is important.
I'm not so quick to settle things by force as you seem to be.
*grump*!
Oh, like I have a choice!  It's attack or BE attacked out here.
There are friendly folks even amongst monsters.  Like myself for example.
How can you say that when you were chasing me mere moments ago?
I was a bit out of sorts on account of the miasma.  I couldn't help it, could I.
Well then, you returned to normal when I destroyed the bordermoon?
Exactly.  When the miasma isn't around, some of us are decent folk.
Hmmm.
Once you destroy a bordermoon,
if you see anyone who stands still, you should try talking to them.  Surely they'll lend you a hand.
Will do!
Kukuku...  Then shall you allow me to take my leave?
Farewell, young lady.
Apologies.  I'm fresh out of hints.
Kuku, kukuku....
Hey.
Oh?  Mademoiselle.  Kukuku...  Have you some business with me?
Do you know anything about sacred items?
Hm.  Now that you mention it I do recall hearing that phrase somewhere.
Oh?  You know something?
Say, tell me!  Where are they?!
I couldn't give you a specific location.  But, what I heard went a little something like this:
"Stand in the heart of a cross inscribed upon an underworld lake and sacred water shall gush forth."
The heart of a cross inscribed upon an underworld lake?  What's that all about?
There must be a place matching that description somewhere in the labyrinth.
Then, if I can make it there?!
Sacred water...  In other words, holy water, is what you'll acquire.
Thank you.  I'm going to check it out!
Right.  Best of luck to you.  Kukuku....
